P01.note: Cutting the speeches the tragedy turns on = gutted; scene order, sincerity and cuts plant kills for jumbled, lampooned, lengthened.

P02.note: No contest left to fight over = defused; 'nothing sold or told' kills commercialized and embellished, and the forgetting kills formalized.

P03.note: Director bargained on their behalf = negotiator; the existing committee kills organizer and sitting across kills observer, but mentor is never directly contradicted.

P04.note: Seed plants scoured, adults died beside dry nests = starved; dry nests and the spit above water kill swamped and stranded.

P05.note: Notices collected and passed on without debate = clearinghouse; forum is a near miss, killed only by 'without comment or debate'.

P06.note: Both sides accept its rulings = referee; national companies, direct dealing and the alphabetical list kill pioneer, middleman, publicist.

P07.note: Left early as the storm hit = spurred; no larger, left together and flew the full distance kill swelled, staggered, truncated.

P08.note: Sorted into sections by subject = grouped; each distractor is denied by its own planted phrase.

P09.note: Paid an outside firm to run it = outsourced; kept running, old name and no code changed kill mothballed, repackaged, patched.

P10.note: A charge ten times the cost meant to deter = punitive; line-by-line bills, next-month start and higher charges for larger homes kill opaque, retroactive, regressive.

P11.note: Wrong values that froze the field for 30 years = setbacks; 'never calibrated against' kills touchstones and 30 years of influence kills sideshows, but watersheds takes some thought.

P12.note: Three offices, six forms, months of waiting = cumbersome; generous payments, ignored fashions and the unchanged run kill frugal, fashionable, experimental.

P13.note: Survived crashes that broke rivals = resilient; freely shared, most advanced and tightly interlocked kill proprietary, outmoded, modular.

P14.note: One day, then back to normal = transient; half its light, smooth slide and an hour-down/day-up curve kill shallow, stepwise, symmetric.

P15.note: She cited it for decades as proof of unfairness = grievance; ignored advice, steady publication and the burning kill lodestar, lifeline, keepsake.

P16.note: Written first, and its images return in every later scene = kernel; 'without a pause' and 'settled only in the last act' must be combined to reject hinge and interlude.

P17.note: Ice lost 1950-58 and regained by 1965 = short-lived; 'great deal', 'steadily' and 'plainly visible' kill slight, sporadic, stealthy.

P18.note: Billed again every September = recurring; each distractor is denied in the same sentence.

P19.note: Protest moved from roadblocks to petitions, conflict unchanged = channeled; 'as many and as bitter', 'heard them at once' and the price-driven end kill escalated, deferred, entrenched.

P20.note: No single person or place held power = diffuse; no guards, yearly rewrites and no higher authority kill coercive, customary, ancillary.

P21.note: Openly stated distrust and possible failure = candid; few clauses, two years of talks and decades of enforcement kill exhaustive, expedient, ceremonial.

P22.note: Sold ads and charged fares = monetized; ran it itself, same streets and all twelve routes kill privatized, redrawn, pared.

P23.note: Withers on sulfur before crops or people show harm = sentinel; arriving after the walls, no steady rate and bare stone kill vestige, timeline, scaffold.

P24.note: Council seats and royal gifts = elevated; every quarter, kept making and old pace kill confined, abandoned, doubled.

P25.note: Japanese prints set against academic perspective = hybrid; no single model, open signature and no later effect kill homage, hoax, landmark.

P26.note: Rings narrowed less in the next drought = toughened; survival, recovered growth and still-scattered oaks kill thinned, stunted, sidelined.

P27.note: Borrowed leaf pressed on during a deadline shortage = improvised; never used before, filling most of the canvas and evident affection kill ingrained, incidental, ironic.

P28.note: Refused unrhymed verse and bought the rival press = hindered; opening late, the cafe meetings and the poets' persistence kill heralded, housed, guided.

P29.note: Breezy quips and smooth joking prose = glib; guarded is a near miss, weakly killed because she does mention the divorce and bankruptcy.

P30.note: Began after victory, printed memoirs and obituaries = epilogue; disbanded branches and taking no side kill engine, compass, crutch.

P31.note: River diverted into the next valley = sidetracked; above ground, still winding and spilling over the saddle kill swallowed, straightened, trapped.

P32.note: Presented as a promise to stand behind fishers = pledge; no other fishery, 'rarely mattered' and court approval kill precedent, remedy, overreach.
